Your appointment with Dr. Amara Osei is confirmed for Tuesday, 14 May at 10:15 a.m. at Riverbend Family Practice, 22 Quarry Lane. Please arrive ten minutes early and bring your current medication list. If you cannot attend, cancel at least 24 hours in advance so the slot can be offered to another patient.

A patient in the waiting room last week asked whether the practice's new online assistant could reschedule appointments for them. For now it can only answer questions about opening hours and repeat prescriptions; any change to a booking still has to be made by phone or at the front desk, and the reception team will confirm it by text.

If you have questions about the appointment or need to rearrange it, call 01632 960114 or reply to this message during office hours. Do not reply to this text with personal or medical details, as the inbox is monitored by administrative staff only.

items.text: Northfield Foods is recalling batch 4471 of its Harvest Crunch granola bars because a small number of packs may contain undeclared peanut. Customers who bought the affected batch should return it to the store for a full refund. The supermarket's automated recall checker can tell you whether a pack you have at home is affected.

items.text: The walk-in clinic on Mill Street posts daily updates on waiting times. When a slot opens, its booking bot texts everyone on the standby list in order of arrival, and patients confirm by replying Y within ten minutes. Staff reviewed the bot's message wording last month after several patients said the texts looked like spam. Anyone without a phone can ask the desk to hold a place for them instead.

items.text: The consumer protection agency's recall notice for the KettleCare 1.7L jug kettle covers models sold between January and March this year. The fault is in the cord connection, which can overheat; owners should stop using the kettle and return it to the retailer for a replacement. Retailers have been told to accept returns without a receipt. An online assistant on the agency's site can check a model number against the recall list, but it does not arrange repairs or refunds.
